verdict.rationale: A state business and lien registry could reasonably offer a filing and search API, so this axis applies. The evidence only describes UI flows behind an account login (search, file, order copies) plus 'Data and Image Subscriptions', which is a bulk-data product, not an API matching the UI. Probes found the public front door behind a Radware bot-wall CAPTCHA, and no documented API for filing, ordering, or search appears anywhere in the pack.
